title: Abusive and Threatening Language Detection in Urdu using Boosting based and BERT based models: A Comparative Approach
reasoning: The paper focuses on the detection of abusive and threatening language in Urdu as part of a shared task competition. While it mentions real-world examples of religious-based violence in the introduction to establish the importance of the research, it does not evaluate, study, or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the work.
